reasons.single-two-at-risk-business-losses: Schedule 1 line 3 correctly takes the Form 6198 allowable losses (1,600), while S1-F1040-195 demands the sum of Schedule C line 31 (-2,000); how MeF expects the at-risk limit on NetProfitOrLossAmt is unverified.
reasons.single-form2555-full-year-physical-prese: The full Form 2555 exclusion leaves every amount F1040-065-05 lists at zero; MeF rejects an all-zero return.
reasons.single-form461-schedule-c-excess-busines: Form 8995 has no filing route yet for a single-business net QBI loss carryforward alongside a Form 461 excess business loss; the node guard stops it.
reasons.single-multiple-schedule-c-net-loss: Schedule C lines 31 round 10,000.49 and -20,000.50 separately (-10,001) while Schedule 1 line 3 rounds the cent total (-10,000), as the Form 1040 rounding instructions allow; S1-F1040-195 needs exact equality.
